newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SICOM to start computerised order rubber sessions.
newsitem.headline: SICOM to start computerised order rubber sessions.

text.p: The Singapore Commodity Exchange (SICOM) is to start computerised order-driven trading sessions for its RSS1, RSS3 and TSR20 rubber futures contracts on Monday, a SICOM spokeswoman said on Friday.
The exchange is organising a seminar on the new trading system, announced in July, in conjuction with the Thai Rubber Association at Hatyai in southern Thailand at the weekend, she said.

There will be two computerised order-driven trading sessions daily. The first will take place between 0340 and 0401 GMT, while the afternoon ring session will be held from 0840 to 0901 GMT, SICOM said.
"At the end of each morning and afternoon ring session, SICOM will determine the official noon prices and daily settlement prices for each of the contracts," it added.
During ring sessions, SICOM's system will accept and execute orders according to the best bid and offer prices and earliest time of entry.
The quantity and price traded will be shown on the screens of the trading system and fed to news vendors, such as Reuters, on a real-time basis.
